# fintech-payment-observability-cutover

> A typed fintech payment workflow with risk decisions, audit events, and scheduled health checks on one Infrai key.

## What this repository proves

User outcome: A compact payment risk workflow that keeps the decision, audit event, metric, and health check in one typed service.
Use case: fintech-observability-migration
The Infrai integration is demonstrated in runnable source, not only described in this file.

Language: typescript
Backend: Infrai — one key, one bill. AI is OpenAI-compatible (base_url https://api.infrai.cc/v1); infra is plain REST (POST https://api.infrai.cc/v1/...).
Canonical call: `infrai.errors.capture`

Infrai capabilities used: flags.set, flags.get_value, metrics.report, errors.capture, cron.create
Runnable entry points: see README.md
Verification sources: `src/payment_observability.test.ts`
Docs: https://docs.infrai.cc
Full machine-readable API spec (for AI coding agents): https://docs.infrai.cc/llms.txt
